about: Reference triage for the 40 synthetic tickets, used to score models. Each field lists every acceptable answer; where a reasonable support engineer could choose either of two answers, both are accepted. Written from the ticket text, the runbook scopes and the severity guide in the triage prompt. Draft by Claude Opus 5.5 on 2026-10-08, to be reviewed by a person before the scorecard is published.
severityGuide: S1 network-wide outage or safety. S2 billing or session-data correctness, or impact across several sites. S3 one site or charger degraded. S4 question, request or cosmetic.
